# Greek letters {#sec-02_greek}

## Concepts and intutions {.unnumbered}

Do you recognize this?

(zeta  + xi)^2 = zeta^2 + xi^2 + 2 zeta  xi

After staring for a while, one might realize that this is identité remarquable.
In fact it exactly the same as (a + b) ^ 2 = a^2 + b^2 + 2ab.

This is the same as 13 + 9 = 22
But this is the same as XIII + IX = XXII.

The romans were not great with maths.

One challenge is we don't know how to read.

In short, these are just symbols,  they function as any other notation
y = a x + b is y =  alpha x + beta.

For some reasons, they might look more complicated, and to a certain extant more relevant. I am alpha and omega. Is less than I am a and z.
But that is not the best way to use them.
